title: Fit & Tuning
blurb: Under- and overfitting, regularisation, and what actually moves them.
source: AWS Certified AI Practitioner (AIF-C01) exam guide · Domain 1
hint: Compare training performance with validation or test performance: both poor suggests underfitting, while a large training-to-validation gap suggests overfitting.
